about: Edge audit (plan Task 5, spec §8.3). `sample`: 60 edges drawn without replacement from the strong edges of the fixture pool, sorted by 'a|b', with mulberry32(seed) indexes; each judged by reading both cards' synced texts: true = a real interaction a player can use, lenient = true but conditional or weak, false = wrong. Precision is over the 60. Rounds before this one (seeds 20261113-20261117) were used to find and fix rules and are not counted. After this sample, the three `false` patterns were fixed (they are no longer strong); that fix changed the strong set by -18 edges and added 4 (Silver Surfer with Jack Flag, Sebastian Shaw, Superior Spider-Man, Venus), which were read and judged true. `knownTrue` must be strong, `knownUnrelated` must not, `anti` must come out as anti-synergy.
